fields.description:
The login form breaks when the user enters special characters in the password field. Steps to reproduce:
1. Go to /login
2. Enter any username
3. Enter a password with characters like & < > "
4. Click Login

Expected: successful login
Actual: 500 error

comments.body: I can reproduce this on Chrome and Firefox.
Working on a fix now. The issue is in the HTML encoding middleware.
